title: Your Apps Aren't Agent-Ready #shorts
description:
AI agents reason well but stall on real professional software — the usual options are brittle UI automation, thin APIs, or a toy reimplementation.

CLI-Anything (HKUDS) automatically generates a command-line interface for an application so agents can drive it directly. A fully automated 7-phase pipeline analyses the source, designs the command architecture and state model, implements a Click CLI with a REPL, plans and writes tests, documents the output, and publishes to PyPI.

It generates valid project files (ODF, MLT XML, SVG) and delegates rendering to the real application rather than reimplementing it. Every generated CLI ships a `--json` flag for structured machine output and standard `--help` for capability discovery, plus a shared REPL experience across tools.

47.5k stars · 50+ applications tested · 2,464 tests passing (stated 100% pass rate) · Apache-2.0.

▶ FULL AI BRIEFING (today's long-form): https://youtu.be/qeqif6iasO0

📦 Repo: https://github.com/HKUDS/CLI-Anything
